intelligence.title_original: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
intelligence.title_zh: 航空业面临更热、更多风暴的天空——乘客可能不得不接受更多航班中断
intelligence.summary_source: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?
intelligence.summary_zh: 随着全球气候变化加剧，英国和北欧的雷暴与极端高温导致机场空域拥堵，数百架航班延误或取消。行业专家警告称，未来天气系统将变得更加不稳定，此类航班中断和延误事件将变得更加频繁，给航空公司、机场和旅客带来沉重的成本与安全隐患。
intelligence.why_zh: 突显气候变化对全球交通基础设施的实际冲击，对航空业运营韧性与风险管理提出了新的政策和防范要求。观点基于航空专家分析，事实基于夏季航班延误数据。
intelligence.poster_phrase: 极端天气致航空大面积延误

intelligence.title_original: Record-low reservoirs and a drought-stricken Canada are quietly pulling the plug on America's hydropower foundation, and the clean energy future that depends on it - Energies Media
intelligence.title_zh: 水库水位创新低与遭遇干旱的加拿大正悄然切断美国的美国水电基础及其依赖的清洁能源未来
intelligence.summary_source: Record-low reservoirs and a drought-stricken Canada are quietly pulling the plug on America's hydropower foundation, and the clean energy future that depends on it Energies Media
intelligence.summary_zh: 美国水库水位降至历史新低，加上遭遇严重干旱的加拿大，正对美国的水电基础及其清洁能源发展构成严重威胁。这一状况削弱了依赖水电支撑的清洁能源转型底座，对未来的减排与能源安全产生深远影响。
intelligence.why_zh: 警示气候极端干旱正在动摇跨境清洁能源供应基础，对美国长期能源转型与区域电力规划具有重要政策影响。观点指向清洁能源未来，事实基于水库水位创新低。
intelligence.poster_phrase: 干旱威胁美国水电基础

molecule.decision_atom: 警示气候极端干旱正在动摇跨境清洁能源供应基础，对美国长期能源转型与区域电力规划具有重要政策影响。观点指向清洁能源未来，事实基于水库水位创新低。

intelligence.title_original: PB Fintech FY26 BRSR: Workforce hits 28,330, emissions rise 21% - scanx.trade
intelligence.title_zh: PB Fintech 26 财年 BRSR：员工总数达 28,330 人，碳排放量上升 21%
intelligence.summary_source: PB Fintech FY26 BRSR: Workforce hits 28,330, emissions rise 21% scanx.trade
intelligence.summary_zh: 根据 PB Fintech 26 财年商业责任与可持续发展报告（BRSR），其员工总数已达到 28,330 人，同时碳排放量较此前上升了 21%。该数据反映了企业在业务扩张过程中员工规模与温室气体排放的双重变化，体现了金融科技企业在可持续发展披露方面的新进展。
intelligence.why_zh: 该报告披露了金融科技企业在运营扩张中的碳排放增长与员工规模数据，为评估非能源行业企业落实可持续发展报告要求及碳绩效管理提供了具体事实。

map_events_week.summary_zh: 南非正通过种植耐旱的肉质植物多株猪毛菜来推进基于自然的碳汇项目，并获得了世界银行发行的一点二亿美元成果导向债券及亚马逊等国际科技企业的资金支持。然而，相关调查披露，该碳信用市场由国际企业主导，其投资承诺难以接受公众监督，且面临项目失败和透明度不足的隐患。
map_events_week.summary_source: - The drought-adapted succulent spekboom (Portulacaria afra) has long been trumpeted as the crown prince of South Africa’s nature-based carbon sink solutions. - The World Bank ensured its coronation with a $120 million outcome-based bond, structured and named in its honor. - According to Amazon, the tech giant’s commitment to buy carbon credits from the first developer to draw on the bond gave other financiers the confidence to back the industrial-scale project. Does this make the tech giant the power behind the throne of an emerging nature-based carbon credit sector? - Mongabay’s investigation uncovers a sector dominated by international corporations whose investment promises are hard to scrutinize, in a cautionary tale of what happens when projects fail.

map_events_week.title_zh: 访谈：澳中光伏合作为世界提供动力——澳大利亚太阳能先驱访谈
map_events_week.title_original: Interview : Australia - China PV collaboration powers world : Australian solar pioneer - Xinhua
map_events_week.summary_zh: 澳大利亚新南威尔士大学教授马丁·格林在接受新华社采访时表示，中澳在光伏领域的长期合作极大地推动了全球绿色转型。他指出，中国强大的制造规模与澳大利亚的技术创新相结合，使光伏成为全球最便宜的电力来源之一。格林近期刚在北京被授予 2025 年度中国国际科学技术合作奖，并回顾了自 1981 年起培养中国光伏科研人才及助力中国光伏产业建立的历程。
map_events_week.source_name: 中国官方气候来源（GDELT定向发现）

map_events_week.title_zh: 墨西哥与巴西的石油协议引发对生态系统和能源转型的担忧
map_events_week.title_original: Mexico-Brazil oil deal raises concern for ecosystems and energy transition
map_events_week.summary_zh: 巴西国家石油公司与墨西哥国家石油公司于今年 6 月宣布建立为期两年的合作伙伴关系，计划在墨西哥湾共同开发成熟油田和深水油田。环保人士与研究人员对此表示担忧，认为缺乏透明度的协议可能导致两国陷入长达数十年的化石燃料排放，并增加墨西哥湾海洋生态系统的污染与生态风险。
map_events_week.summary_source: - This June, Pemex and Petrobras, the state fossil fuel companies of Mexico and Brazil respectively, announced a two-year partnership to jointly explore mature and deepwater oilfields in the Gulf of Mexico. - Details of the exact arrangement have not been released, despite both companies being state-run and campaigners’ calls for greater transparency, but subsequent reports suggest that exploration could focus on the Bay of Campeche, near the Gulf’s largest marine protected area and several vulnerable reef habitats. - Both companies have downplayed the significance of the deal as a preliminary step, but environmental campaigners said it risks tying both nations to decades of fossil fuel emissions and pollution. - Supporters hope the partnership will help staunch a recent run of safety incidents at Mexican petrochemical sites.

map_events_week.title_zh: 分析：2026年第二季度中国二氧化碳排放因石油使用量骤降而下降
map_events_week.title_original: Analysis: China’s CO2 emissions fall in Q2 2026 due to plummeting oil use
map_events_week.summary_zh: 由于霍尔木兹海峡危机导致石油供应中断，2026年第二季度中国二氧化碳排放量下降了1%。这是历史上首次因石油消耗量下降而直接推动全国总体碳排放减少，其中石油总体使用量下降9%，交通领域用油下降16%，尽管煤炭发电量持续反弹，但仍未能阻止碳排放的整体回落。
map_events_week.summary_source: China’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions fell by 1% in the second quarter of 2026, as oil consumption plummeted amid the… The post Analysis: China’s CO2 emissions fall in Q2 2026 due to plummeting oil use appeared first on Carbon Brief .

map_events_week.title_zh: 入侵者冲击亚马逊原住民土地，威胁隔离部落
map_events_week.title_original: Invaders storm Indigenous Amazon land, threatening isolated people
map_events_week.summary_zh: 自8月中旬以来，约有200人闯入巴西帕拉州的伊图纳/伊塔塔原住民领地，破坏巴西原住民事务局的大门并建立营地。新设立的环保区与联邦保护的原住民土地完全重叠引发了法律混乱，被侵占者利用来进行农牧业活动，联邦当局警告称这给自愿隔离的原住民带来了迫在眉睫的暴力对抗和潜在灭绝风险。
map_events_week.summary_source: - About 200 people have invaded the Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land in Brazil’s Pará state since August 13, breaking through Brazil’s Indigenous Affairs Agency (Funai) gates, removing signs and establishing camps. - The invasion followed the creation of the Bacajaí Environmental Protection Area that completely overlaps with the federally protected Indigenous Land — creating legal confusion which authorities say has been exploited by individuals who wish to occupy the area. - Federal authorities have warned of an imminent risk of confrontation and potentially genocide against Indigenous people living in voluntary isolation and have called for the urgent deployment of the National Force and Federal Police. - On August 26, a federal court ordered the Union and Funai to send teams from the Public Security Force within 48 hours to contain the invasion but the deadline has passed and the teams have not yet arrived.

map_events_week.title_zh: 英国气象局称2026年夏季是英国有记录以来最热的一年

map_events_week.summary_source: Meteorologists say mean average temperature of 16.5C was made 130 times more likely by climate crisis This year’s summer was the UK’s hottest on record, according to provisional data, and the Met Office said the season’s mean temperature was made 130 times more likely by the climate crisis. Record-breaking and back-to-back heatwaves have scorched much of Europe. In England, temperatures peaked at 38.1C (100.1F) at Kew Gardens in London on 13 August, and June had already been confirmed as the country’s hottest since records began in 1884 . Scientists have said these heatwaves are only possible because of the climate crisis driven by burning fossil fuels. Continue reading...

map_events_week.title_original: Hyundai Steel's US mill to cut carbon emissions 70% vs. blast furnace - 헤럴드경제
map_events_week.summary_zh: 现代制钢公司的美国工厂计划将其碳排放量较传统高炉大幅削减百分之七十，这一减排举措将对钢铁行业的低碳转型产生重要影响。
map_events_week.summary_source: Hyundai Steel's US mill to cut carbon emissions 70% vs. blast furnace 헤럴드경제

map_events_week.title_zh: 分析：2026年夏季英国太阳能发电量创历史新高
map_events_week.title_original: Analysis: UK solar power hits record high over summer 2026
map_events_week.summary_zh: 受持续高温和晴朗天气驱动，2026年夏季英国太阳能发电量创下历史新高。在6月至8月期间，英国太阳能发电总量达到8.8太瓦时，较2025年同期增长23%，其中7月份单月发电量达到创纪录的3.3太瓦时。
map_events_week.summary_source: Solar power generation in the UK reached a new record over the summer of 2026, as temperatures across the nation… The post Analysis: UK solar power hits record high over summer 2026 appeared first on Carbon Brief .

map_events_week.title_zh: 分析称受伊朗战争减少石油使用影响，中国第二季度碳排放下降
map_events_week.title_original: China emissions fell in Q2 as Iran war pared oil use: analysis - KMVU FOX 26 Medford
map_events_week.summary_zh: 根据相关分析，由于伊朗战争导致石油使用量减少，中国在第二季度的碳排放量出现下降。这一趋势反映了地缘政治冲突对全球化石燃料消费及区域温室气体排放产生的直接传导影响。
map_events_week.summary_source: China emissions fell in Q2 as Iran war pared oil use: analysis KMVU FOX 26 Medford

map_events_week.title_zh: 在厄瓜多尔因塔格山谷，社区建设自己的微型水电站
map_events_week.title_original: In Ecuador’s Intag Valley, communities build their own micro-hydropower plant
map_events_week.summary_zh: 在厄瓜多尔因塔格山谷，来自四个社区的19户家庭正在开发一个300千瓦的径流式水电项目。该项目名为HidroAguagrún，当地社区拥有其90%的股份，电网售电净收入的一半将直接注入信托基金用于云雾森林保护等环保活动，为抵御大型资源开采提供了一种社区拥有的可再生能源替代模式。
map_events_week.summary_source: - In Ecuador’s Intag Valley, 19 families are developing a 300-kilowatt hydropower project that can provide an alternative source of income to the large-scale extractive and productive industries that are common in the Imbabura province. - The communities own 90% of the HidroAguagrún project and half of its net electricity revenue will go directly into a trust for conservation activities once the plant is fully operational. - The project offers a potential model for community-owned renewable energy, but replicability depends on community willingness and cohesion, water availability and funding.

map_events_week.title_zh: 澳大利亚新建的环境保护署批准煤炭项目，引发气候组织愤怒
map_events_week.title_original: Australia’s new environmental protection agency approves coal project, angering climate groups
map_events_week.summary_zh: 澳大利亚国家环境保护署批准了其自 7 月 1 日运营以来的首个煤炭项目，允许昆士兰州的萨拉吉露天煤矿继续开采至 2055 年，期间将开采并出口用于炼钢的煤炭。该项目扩建引发了气候团体的批评，此前总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯曾否认澳大利亚的化石燃料出口引发了与太平洋岛国领导人的紧张关系。
map_events_week.summary_source: Queensland open-cut Saraji mine will be able to keep digging until 2055 as Anthony Albanese denies tensions with Pacific leaders over fossil fuels Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s new national agency for environmental protection has approved its first coal project, allowing a Queensland open-cut mine to keep digging until 2055 while clearing threatened woodland and koala habitat. The confirmation of the extension of the Saraji mine, which digs and exports coal for steel making, comes after the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, denied this week there was tension over Australia’s fossil fuel exports during talks with Pacific leaders. map_events_week.title_zh: 专栏：加拿大的气候目标真的具有约束力吗？
map_events_week.title_original: COLUMN: Were Canada’s climate targets really binding? - Kelowna Capital News
map_events_week.summary_zh: 一篇专栏文章探讨并质疑了加拿大既定气候目标的法律约束力与实际执行效力，引发对国家气候政策承诺落实情况的讨论。
map_events_week.summary_source: COLUMN: Were Canada’s climate targets really binding? Kelowna Capital News

map_events_week.title_zh: 尼泊尔与中国突发洪水导致1200多人死亡
map_events_week.title_original: More than 1,200 dead in Nepal, China after flash floods - nhk.or.jp
map_events_week.summary_zh: 根据NHK报道，尼泊尔与中国在发生突发洪水后，已造成1200多人死亡。相关灾情引发国际社会对极端天气影响及防灾减灾能力的广泛关注。
map_events_week.summary_source: More than 1,200 dead in Nepal, China after flash floods nhk.or.jp

map_events_week.title_zh: 英国气象局公布 2026-2027 年新风暴命名
map_events_week.title_original: New storm names for 2026-2027 released by Met Office
map_events_week.summary_zh: 随着英国气象季的临近，英国气象局联合爱尔兰和荷兰气象机构公布了 2026-2027 年度的风暴命名名单。新名单由公众提交的超四万条建议中选出，包括奥斯滕、克洛伊和伊芙琳等名称，旨在对预计产生中高影响的严重天气进行清晰一致的预警。
map_events_week.summary_source: Tuesday 1 September marks the start of the UK storm season and a new list of storm names have been released including Austen, Chloe and Evelyn.

map_events_week.title_zh: 密歇根州投资 750 万美元探寻是否拥有清洁能源金矿
map_events_week.title_original: Michigan invests $7.5M to find out if it’s sitting on a clean energy gold mine
map_events_week.summary_zh: 美国密歇根州投资 750 万美元用于研究地质氢。这种蕴藏在地表之下的零碳能源有望帮助交通运输、钢铁制造等高排放行业实现去碳化，并摆脱对化石燃料的依赖。
map_events_week.summary_source: The funding will go toward researching geologic hydrogen, a carbon-free energy source buried beneath the state that could clean up heavy-emitting industries like transportation.

map_events_week.title_zh: 台风“沙德尔”袭击中国东部，24.7万居民撤离洪涝区
map_events_week.title_original: Typhoon Saudel Lashes Eastern China as 247,000 Residents Flee Flood Zones - streamlinefeed.co.ke
map_events_week.summary_zh: 台风“沙德尔”正面袭击中国东部地区，引发严重洪涝威胁。面对严峻的风雨灾害，当地已有24.7万名居民紧急撤离危险的洪涝区，以保障生命安全并防范次生灾害。
map_events_week.summary_source: Typhoon Saudel Lashes Eastern China as 247,000 Residents Flee Flood Zones streamlinefeed.co.ke

map_events_week.title_zh: 干旱与疾病将德文郡农民逼向极限
map_events_week.title_original: Drought and disease push Devon farmers ‘to the limit’ - Crediton Courier
map_events_week.summary_zh: 干旱和疾病正将英国德文郡的农民逼向极限，对当地农业生产和农户生计造成严重威胁。
map_events_week.summary_source: Drought and disease push Devon farmers ‘to the limit’ Crediton Courier

map_events_week.title_zh: 澳大利亚过去一年的排放量下降了1.6%，但这远远不够
map_events_week.title_original: Australia’s emissions have fallen 1.6% in the last year. That’s nowhere near enough - thepoint.com.au
map_events_week.summary_zh: 最新数据显示，澳大利亚在过去一年中的温室气体排放量下降了 1.6%。然而，相关分析指出这一减排速度远远无法满足应对气候变化的要求，凸显出该国亟需采取更加激进和深度的减排政策与措施。
map_events_week.summary_source: Australia’s emissions have fallen 1.6% in the last year. That’s nowhere near enough thepoint.com.au

map_events_week.title_zh: 气候变化加剧全美极端高温、洪水与热带风暴威胁
map_events_week.title_original: Climate change fuels extreme heat, flooding and tropical threats across the U.S. - Climate Central
map_events_week.summary_zh: 根据气候中央组织发布的信息，气候变化正在全美范围内助长极端高温、洪水以及热带气旋等各类极端天气与气候威胁，对当地生态环境和公共安全造成持续影响。
map_events_week.summary_source: Climate change fuels extreme heat, flooding and tropical threats across the U.S. Climate Central

map_events_week.title_zh: 中俄首次北极现场海冰观测为气候变化与航运前景提供参考：中国专家
map_events_week.title_original: China-Russia first Arctic on-site sea-ice observation sheds light on climate change, shipping prospects: Chinese expert - Global Times
map_events_week.summary_zh: 中俄两国开展了首次北极现场海冰观测，相关成果为深入理解气候变化以及北极航运的发展前景提供了重要科学参考。中国专家指出，此次现场观测具有积极意义。
map_events_week.summary_source: China-Russia first Arctic on-site sea-ice observation sheds light on climate change, shipping prospects: Chinese expert Global Times

map_events_week.theme: 汽车排放标准与市场价格
map_events_week.title_zh: 现在买入吗？随着 EPA 2027 年排放标准的出台，卡车价格正在上涨
map_events_week.title_original: Buy now? Truck prices on the way up with EPA 2027 emissions - overdriveonline.com
map_events_week.summary_zh: 随着美国环保署（EPA）2027年排放标准的临近，卡车价格呈现上涨趋势。这一政策调整预计将推高商用车制造和合规成本，进而影响终端市场购车价格，对物流及货运业的车辆采购决策产生直接压力。
map_events_week.summary_source: Buy now? Truck prices on the way up with EPA 2027 emissions overdriveonline.com

map_events_week.title_zh: 新研究表明关键树种促进亚马逊森林恢复
map_events_week.title_original: Key tree species boost Amazon forest restoration, new study shows
map_events_week.summary_zh: 发表在《全球变化生物学》上的一项研究显示，在再生亚马逊森林中，仅15至25种树木就占了树木总数和碳储量近的一半。了解这些森林动态有助于巴西实现到2030年恢复1200万公顷森林的国际承诺。
map_events_week.summary_source: - A study in Global Change Biology shows that just 15 to 25 tree species make up nearly half of the trees and carbon stocks in regrowing Amazon forests. - While pioneer species grow quickly, experts warn that forests need a robust succession of stronger trees to avoid ecological decline over time. - Understanding these forest dynamics may help Brazil meet its international pledge to restore 12 million hectares (30 million acres) of forest by 2030.
